scope: Qwen coding-subagent success -> Notion DelegationDispatcher result boundary

facts: Qwen runOne marks a coding-subagent result ok=true and sets text=String(final?.content || '') without requiring non-empty final text.
A tool-using child can therefore successfully change/check the workspace yet return an empty final text string.
Notion DelegationDispatcher requires adapter output to be a non-empty string and raises DelegationDispatchError on empty/whitespace output.

A naive Qwen adapter returning result.text would turn a completed persisted Qwen task into a Notion failure. Combined with unstable batch identity this can encourage duplicate side effects; with stable identity it becomes a permanent false failure on every resume.

recommended_contract: Do not use raw result.text as the sole completion signal for Qwen coding delegation.
Treat Qwen ok=true as completion even when text is empty; preserve completion state separately from human-readable output.

If the current text-only Notion dispatcher must remain initially, the Qwen adapter should emit a deterministic non-empty technical completion message for ok=true + empty text, while keeping the persisted Qwen result/batch as source of truth.
Never re-run completed Qwen work merely to obtain a non-empty prose answer.
